_about: The Council's agendas (relationship overhaul, the Council phase, DIRECTOR_BIBLE 5.169-5.177). Every staff member at every club pushes for one. label: what he pushes for, as the Staff screen says it; about: one line on what he wants; jobs: how likely each job is to hold it (weights, 0 = never); weigh: how much a card choice's effects suit him (op, op:+ / op:- by the sign of its d, culture:<strand>:+ / -); voice: what he says when he backs a choice, by manner (blunt, measured, warm), signed in his own name on the card. Read by scripts/sim/Council.gd; checked by Council.check_agendas. Sizes are proposals: balance is the director's call.

youth.label: Bring the kids through
youth.about: Wants young players picked, backed and taught

blunt: The kids have to see a way in, or they'll stop believing there is one
We didn't draft them to sit them in the twos
measured: This is how the young ones learn what the club is about
It's a small cost now for a better list in three years
warm: He'll remember who backed him when it counted
Give the young fella something to hold on to

win_now.label: Win now
win_now.about: Wants the best side on the park every week, whoever it upsets

blunt: Points on the board. Everything else can wait
We're here to win this week, not next year
measured: The ladder doesn't care how we feel. This gives us the best side
It's the call that keeps us in the hunt
warm: The boys want to win more than anything. Give them the best chance

standards.label: Hold the line on standards
standards.about: Wants the rules kept, the same for everyone

blunt: Let this slide and you'll be dealing with it every week
Rules are rules. The group is watching what we do here
measured: If the standard moves for one, it moves for all of them
Consistency now saves us a harder conversation later
warm: They actually want us to be firm. It makes them feel safe

player_care.label: Look after the players
player_care.about: Wants the group happy and heard

blunt: Look after your people. They'll run through walls for you
You lose the room, you lose everything
measured: A happy group plays better footy. That's not soft, it's true
This keeps the group together, and that's worth more than one week
warm: Have a heart here, coach. He needs it

fitness.label: Mind the bodies
fitness.about: Wants no risks taken with tired or sore players

blunt: The numbers say he's cooked. Push him and he breaks
I'm not signing off on that risk
measured: A week's care now beats six weeks on the sidelines
The load data's clear. Give the body what it needs
warm: Let's keep him in one piece. He's got a long career ahead

list_value.label: Build the list
list_value.about: Wants every call made with the list in five years in mind

blunt: Lock in the talent. Players like him don't come cheap
Think about the list, not the week
measured: This protects what we've built on the list
The long game says this one
warm: He's part of what we're building. Keep him close
